source: https://bohohippychic.com.au/products.json?limit=250&page=N (public storefront endpoint), pages products-page1.json, products-page2.json, products-page3.json

rules: same size option values (trimmed, upper case, order ignored)
same title stem: title tokens without colour words, print words and variant codes like PWP1 (src/families.ts COLOUR_WORDS, SHADE_MODIFIERS next to a colour, PRINT_WORDS, /^[a-z]{2,4}\d{1,3}$/)

same description key: sentences without shop boilerplate (8 patterns: "not included", colour disclaimers, styling advice, model notes), lower case, punctuation dropped, colour/print/code words and the member's own variant name removed; numbers (measurements) kept

or (rule 4b) a similar description key: same type, sizes and title stem, the same numbers in the same order (at least 2), and token-set Jaccard >= 0.9; complete linkage, so similarity never chains. Absorbs one-phrase copy edits ("Best seller in store", "Crafted in a deep navy,"). Members joined this way carry descriptionJaccard and a note; families with one have textMatch "similar"

silhouette check on the main photo when downloaded: main-mask.png when present, else the foreground against the border colours (plain backdrops only: at most 4 border colours, subject not cut off at the top or sides), bounding box scaled to 64×128, IoU (mirror allowed) against the cluster seed; below 0.6 = a different cut, the family is split (ids with ~2, ~3)
method.reference: best photos: main photo classified as without a model first (images.json; the five validation products only), then the largest main photo (pixels), then the most images, then the handle
method.ownAsset: a member whose fabric or size chart (buildShopPayload: fabric, sizeChartType, sizeChart, ease, lengthCm) differs from the reference needs its own full run; every other member only needs stage 4b (re-texture)
method.assetEligible: product types the engine builds assets for today: Dresses, Tops, Pants, Skirts, Jackets & Knits, Clothing
pendingCategory: Jumpsuits & Sets: eligible once the category exists (overalls, jumpsuits and pant suits span torso and legs: no engine category (the schema reads the type as "dress", which has no legs), no combined dress + bottom anchor subset, no control proxy with legs, and no validation product (export:phase0 --shop refuses them)); counted in counts.pendingCategory, not in counts.assetEligible
limits: Every main photo on this shop is on a model in a styled set (busy background, legs or head cut off), so no reference is "without a model" and the border-colour mask refuses the photos (silhouette.failedByReason). The silhouette check is implemented and tested on fixtures but splits nothing here; it needs plain-backdrop photos or garment masks from a segmentation model (main-mask.png, e.g. stage 1b Grounding DINO + SAM 2 on Modal).

Rule 4b joins one-phrase copy edits only when the measurement numbers are equal and at least 2; copy without measurements, or rewritten more than that (e.g. one of the Earthweave tops), stays its own family. Such near misses cost a full run, never a wrong merge.
Title stems are over-stripped where a print word is also part of the name (Desert Bloom → "desert dress"); this only changes ids, since the description must still match.
Size labels are compared as written: "L-XL" and "LG-XL" are different values.

silhouette.photo: main-w200.png: the main photo at width 200 as PNG from the Shopify CDN, in raw/<handle>/ (gitignored)

failedExamples.reason: not a plain backdrop: 4 border colours explain only 31 % of the border
not a plain backdrop: 4 border colours explain only 43 % of the border
not a plain backdrop: 4 border colours explain only 36 % of the border
not a plain backdrop: 4 border colours explain only 40 % of the border
not a plain backdrop: 4 border colours explain only 47 % of the border

calibration.note: withinTextFamily: members against their text family reference; acrossFamiliesSameType: references of different text families of one product type (different cuts). The threshold sits where few within-family pairs fall below it.

counts.note: assetEligible = types the engine can build today; pendingCategory = garment types it cannot build yet (no category or proxy), NOT included in assetEligible; productsSaved = members that only need stage 4b instead of a full run; fullRuns = one per family plus every member with ownAsset

nearMisses.note: Same product type, sizes and title stem, but description keys that are neither equal nor similar under rule 4b (different measurements, no measurements, or more rewritten copy), so different families. The rules never merge them. Some are one cut with rewritten copy (Earthweave Knit Top, Nomad Cotton Jacket), others are different cuts with a generic stem ("maxi dress" after removing print names); a merchant who confirms one cut saves one full run per extra family, so the savable number is an upper bound.
